# Can the Deployment Endpoint PD Gains Be Adjusted Directly in MuJoCo or Real-World Deployment When the Strategy Fails to Walk?

> **Current answer:** The repository members explicitly stated in the original post that the ratio of the deployment endpoint - differential gain (kp/kd) should remain consistent with the training environment, and neither simulation nor real-world deployment should alter it. Since the original post did not provide the results of the retest, this experience is used to exclude gain inconsistency as the sole cause. The case is not proven to have only this one reason.

- The strategy fails to walk in MuJoCo after deployment; should the kp/kd be re-adjusted at the deployment endpoint?
- The robot cannot walk normally in MuJoCo.
